title: 2023 AMC 12B Problem 9
statement:
What is the area of the region in the coordinate plane defined by

\[ ||x|-1|+||y|-1|\le 1? \]

solutions.text:
Replacing \(x,y\) by \(|x|,|y|,\) the condition \(|x-1|+|y-1|\le 1\) describes a diamond centered at \((1,1)\) with diagonals of length \(2,\) hence area \(2.\) It lies entirely in the first quadrant (touching the axes only at single points), so reflecting across the two axes produces \(4\) disjoint copies. The total area is \(4\times 2=8.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
